steps.content:
22:10, December 9, N.F. 114
The Rust
An Abandoned Theater
Where WhiteSands meets the Rust stands a long-abandoned theater.

Several broken Puppet bodies lie scattered nearby. They bear the same traits as those found at the cabinet attack site—initially destroyed by someone, then completely dominated and enhanced by an even more formidable Mania power.
The 9th Agency stumbled upon this location during their pursuit of the Underground Puppets, and of course, it could very well be that someone was intentionally leading you here.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It seems like... her mission is really completed.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'll stay right here and wait for her. I know she will come, and it won't be long.
Your shackles have already sensed her approach, but before that...
Fine droplets of rain fall sparsely, emanating a soft cyan glow. This isn't the Blue Rain, but more like those silver threads that cascaded around her that night.
And with the rain comes more Underground Puppets, their bodies twitching as they approach.
The single-eye runes on their faces have long since faded, replaced by a trail of cyan tears.
In contrast to the ordinary Puppets that attacked the mansion, these exhibit unsettling, unnatural movements while exuding formidable power—potent enough to rival even HUSH's elite units.

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: The Mania characteristics have changed. Her power is extremely dangerous now. Chief...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'll stay here by myself. The more people around, the greater the danger. I'm afraid her power can manipulate weakened or dead creatures.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't worry... She won't attack me. She must have something to say.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Please activate the Blue Rain in the area to suppress the Mania, and... just let the FAC's auto units handle these Puppets.
